wiki.title: Two of Three
wiki.text:
Two of Three is an enemy NPC that can be found wandering in designated spawn areas that include: North of the Cursed Graveyard located in Stillwater Crossing, and north of the spiralmint patch in Highroad Junction.

Trivia
Two of Three was introduced in-game on October 8, 2013.
